title: Build executor schema
description: Format-centric build executor for hyperfrontend library packages. Thin wrapper over @hyperfrontend/builder. All output formats are opt-in.

outputPath.description: Output directory. Supports {projectRoot} placeholder. Defaults to dist/{projectRoot}.

tsConfig.description: Path to tsconfig. Supports {projectRoot} placeholder. Defaults to {projectRoot}/tsconfig.lib.json.

assets.description: Additional asset specs to copy into the build output (in addition to the wrapper's defaults).

external.description: Global external dependencies for all formats.

esm.description: ESM output configuration. Omit to skip.

cjs.description: CJS output configuration. Omit to skip.

iife.description: IIFE bundle configuration. Browser-only. Omit to skip.

umd.description: UMD bundle configuration. Universal format. Omit to skip.

unpkg.description: Custom path for the unpkg field in package.json. Defaults to first UMD bundle's index.umd.min.js path.

jsdelivr.description: Custom path for the jsdelivr field in package.json. Defaults to first UMD bundle's index.umd.min.js path.

bin.description: Bin declarations to synthesize alongside the library. Each declaration produces a JS bin (CJS and/or ESM) and optionally a Node SEA native binary per platform.

dedupeSharedInternals.description: Hoist first-party modules inlined into multiple entry bundles into shared _shared/<srcPath>/ chunks and rewrite entries to import them. Safe additive post-emit pass over esm/cjs outputs. Set false to keep entries fully self-contained.

verbose.description: Enable verbose/debug logging for build diagnostics.

to.description: Output subdirectory relative to outputPath. Defaults to '.'.

files.description: Explicit relative file names to copy.

glob.description: POSIX-style glob pattern, evaluated relative to 'from'.

entry.description: Entry point(s). Exact paths or globs. Omit to use all detected entries.

bundleAllDeps.description: Bundle every third-party dep into _dependencies/<dep>/ so the published artifact is fully self-contained. Pass an object with include/exclude to override the auto-derived dep set.

bundleWorkspaceDeps.description: Inline workspace dependencies (true) or keep them external (false).
Inline workspace dependencies (true) or keep them external (false).

name.description: Bin name (also the package.json#bin key and the source file basename at src/bin/<name>.ts).

format.description: Required output format(s) for the bin.

runner.description: Named runner export to bootstrap. Defaults to the file's default export.

platforms.description: Platforms for which a native binary should be produced.
